partners.mechanism_chain: YAP1 (HGNC:24479) —DISRUPTS→ Hippo signaling pathway (WP:WP485); TJP2 (HGNC:11571) —DISRUPTS→ Hippo signaling pathway (WP:WP485); Hippo signaling pathway (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Uveal coloboma (HP:0000477); Hippo signaling pathway (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Cleft lip and palate (HP:0000204); Hippo signaling pathway (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Hippo signaling pathway (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Intrahepatic cholestasis (HP:0011350).
